abstract: Nanofiltration membranes with high anion selectivity are essential for chloride/sulfate separation. Here, an amikacin interlayer was introduced to regulate interfacial polymerization, producing a polyamide layer with reduced thickness and tailored surface charge. The optimized membrane achieved a water permeance of 25.3 L m-2 h-1 bar-1 and a Cl-/SO42- separation factor of 102, outperforming most reported membranes.
